title: Synergistic effect of Ce–Mg promoted Ni catalysts on 3D structured open cell foams for CO2 hydrogenation to methane
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01653C, Paper
Neha Choudhary, Patrick Da Costa
Zirconia-based open-cell foams coated with Mg-promoted CeNi catalysts exhibit enhanced CO2 methanation due to improved surface basicity. An optimal MgO loading of 10 wt% delivers superior CH4 production compared to unpromoted CeNi foams.
